button.label: HUD
button.name: btn_hud
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the HUD attachments. They come back as they were when you leave the photo screen.

button.label: Simple view
button.name: btn_mode
button.tool_tip: Switch between the detailed view (the world is the shape of the photo, the panels are around it) and the simple view (the world fills the window)

button.label: Photo
button.name: btn_shoot
button.tool_tip: Take the photo now, at the size and shape set in the photo tools

button.label: Exit
button.name: btn_exit
button.tool_tip: Leave the photo screen; the windows and bars come back
